name: Barrister Hamza Tariq
comment: Ordered the Moss Velvet 3-seater along with a custom Sheesham coffee table for my formal drawing room in DHA Lahore. The finish is on par with high-end Italian imports, but at one-third the price. Solid Kikar frame, no wobble, and the nanotech velvet repelled tea spilled during our housewarming dawat effortlessly!

name: Dr. Ayesha Siddiqui
product: Pakwood Varello Grand Extended King Bed Set
comment: Pakwood delivered our master bedroom set right to Islamabad within 14 working days. The team assembled it professionally with hydraulic storage lift. The fluted headboard with integrated floating side tables is magnificent. Genuine Multani seasoned timber quality you simply cannot find in commercial markets.

name: Omer Farooq
product: Pakwood Monarch 8-Seater Solid Sheesham Dining Table
comment: Finding genuine 100% solid Sheesham in Karachi that doesn't warp in coastal humidity is almost impossible. Pakwood's kiln-dried treatment is the real deal. The 8-seater Monarch table is heavy, commanding, and the natural grain striations are a genuine work of art. 10/10 recommendation!

name: Syeda Mahnoor Bukhari
product: Pakwood WoodLuxe Sculptural Solid Sheesham Armchair
comment: Living in Multan, we visited their workshop near Hussain Agahi Market in person before finalizing our order. Seeing the master woodcarvers hand-sanding the arms convinced us instantly. The armchair bouclé fabric is rich, soft, and so comfortable for evening reading.

name: Chaudhry Bilal Warraich
product: Pakwood Hemington Deep-Tufted English Chesterfield Sofa
comment: The deep-button tufting on the Hemington leather sofa is pristine. Every single brass stud is hand-hammered with surgical alignment. Pakwood sent me WhatsApp video updates of the frame before upholstery and upon completion. Pure transparency and royal craftsmanship.

name: Engr. Salman Raza
product: Pakwood Verano Executive Solid Sheesham Desk
comment: Upgraded my home study with the Verano executive desk. The built-in wire routing and lockable Sheesham drawers keep my workspace pristine. Delivery arrived packed in triple-wall corrugated boxes with corner foam guards. Zero scratches.
